turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I would just like to start with what brought you in here today to the family clinic?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, so I've been coughing for a few months now and so that's the problem.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and how many months have you been coughing for?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Just over two, I would say, and it's been I've been bringing up this yellow, greenish sputum. It's kind of gross.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and how, how much of the sputum would you say you're bringing up in an average day? Like a teaspoon? Tablespoon?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: : Oh I see OK. I don't know, maybe a few teaspoons throughout the day.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: At first I thought I I I had a, a chest infection, but even after antibiotics from my GP, or or my family doctor, It never cleared up.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and so when did you go on the antibiotics?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Ah so this is about, uh, about a month ago.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Mhmm.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: And yeah, so I went to see my family doctor about the cough then and dad was prescribed some antibiotics. I think azithromycin and it, it still didn't, it didn't do anything.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, I see. And do you find that your cough has been getting worse since then?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, I would say the cough has been about the same.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. But how about the sputum that you're bringing up, has that increased?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, it's about the same, but it definitely I would say there's a pink tinge in the sputum now. Every once in awhile I've noticed more than than before.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And did this all start after the chest infection or did you have something like this occur before?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, yeah, this all started after.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, I see. Was there anything that happened around that time? Any new environment that you were exposed to?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Ah, well, I did go to India a few months ago.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and how many months was that? Was that also like two months ago?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, about that, probably closer to three or four, but yeah, right around the time that that I think this, uhm cough started or just before I got back.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, I see. And how often are you coughing in a day?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Ah. a few times an hour.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Anything that makes your cough go away now you've tried?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no nothings really helped it go away.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and is it better or worse? During good morning as opposed to night?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, it's pretty, it's pretty bad all day actually and it's been impacting my sleep because I've been coughing at night too.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see. And, um, in terms of things that make it worse, anything you do around the house or at work that makes the coughing worse?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh yeah, I guess if I'm just moving around a little bit more it might bring it on a little bit more, but it's pretty bad all day.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see. And in terms of any other symptoms you might be having, uh, do you have any shortness of breath, runny nose, any chest pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, no, not really.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Besides the pain tinged sputum, have you ever coughed up blood, like red blood?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Not anything that was really bright red. More pink.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: More pink. OK. Yeah, so you traveled to India just two months ago. Do you remember what kind of place you stayed in India? Was it a, a in a crowded place or were you by yourself?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Well, I mean there is a lot of people around. Yeah, there was not a lot of room where I was was staying, so it was pretty crowded.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and was there anyone that was ill around you or any exposure to tuberculosis?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, not that I'm not aware of. I was around my family but, umm, I guess it's possible.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And once you came back did anyone else, in your family get sick? Or was it just you?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Oh yeah, I spoke to my relative went when I got back and they they didn't tell me about one of my cousins there that was feeling sick.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And have you been having any fevers or chills?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I feel I feel like I've been pretty pretty hot sometimes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and how about night sweats?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, the coughs been messing with my sleep, and I've been waking up with night sweats.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And have you been having any headaches?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Ah no headaches.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any do you feel that you've lost any weight recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, maybe a few pounds, but um.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you tried to lose weight, or was that unintentional?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I, I was kind of surprised. I thought I would have gained weight 'cause I've been a bit more lazy recently, but the weight seems to be down anyway.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see, OK. Have you noticed any wheezing sounds when you breathe out, or breathe in?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No wheezing.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And you mentioned no chest pain, right?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, no chest pain.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you noticed any kind of swelling in your legs or hands or anywhere else in your body?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No swelling.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Any bowel movement changes, any constipation or diarrhea? Any of those?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any urinary problems?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any changes in your appetite at all? Do you feel that you've lost any appetite?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um yeah, yeah maybe eating a little bit less.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And in your current environment right now, are you exposed to any fumes or dust or any animals?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, we have a dog, but um, no fumes or anything like anything like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you experienced any kind of dizziness or fainting spells?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. In terms of your past medical history, have you been diagnosed with any medical conditions?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, yeah I meant, uh, high blood pressure. Type 2 diabetes and high cholesterol.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see. And are you taking any medications for any of those?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I'm taking uhm, a few medications for blood pressure and uh, and and diabetes right now, and I think I Rosuvastatin for for the cholesterol. I'm not sure of the other ones though.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, no worries. And do you know if you're allergic to any medications or do you have any environmental allergies?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I think I I got a rash to penicillin when I was when I was younger, but that's it.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any previous hospitalizations?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, nope.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any surgeries?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No surgeries.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and in your family has anyone ever had any cancers or died of a heart attack?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, my mother out a heart attack when she was 48.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And has anyone ever had anything like pulmonary fibrosis or any autoimmune conditions?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm. What are those?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: So pulmonary fibrosis is a condition in your lung where you start getting like these nodules.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I see.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And it can run in the family and that can cause some of the symptoms like a chronic cough. It can cause sometimes shortness of breath and it can sometimes be associated with the like some connective tissue disorders that can run in the family. Umm, any of those ring a bell?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't heard of anything like that in my family.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Yeah, and other than that, where do you currently live? Do you live by yourself or with anyone else?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I live with my husband and three sons just outside of town here.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And have any of them been sick?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, everybody's been feeling well at home.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And do you work currently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no, I'm I retired.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And currently do you smoke? Cigarettes?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah yeah, I smoke about a half a pack of cigarettes per day and ah, I've been trying to cut down.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and how long have you been smoking for?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Ah probably like 30 years.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see and do you use any recreational drugs like marijuana or cocaine?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Ah, no I've never used anything like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and how about alcohol? Do you drink alcohol?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No, OK. Alright, so yeah those are all the questions I had for you today. Do you have any questions for me or any questions or concerns?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, not right now.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so we'll be doing some investigations since you recently traveled to India, we need to make sure that you don't have tuberculosis, as that's prevalent in some parts of India. So we will do some, we might get like a chest X-Ray for that, you may have a pneumonia as well and then we'll go from there. Does that sound good?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, for sure.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK alright well, yeah, well, after those tests have come back, we'll see you in the next appointment for follow up.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Thank you.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: You're welcome.
